run_conformal_evaluation_threshold: run a conformal prediction evaluation using the threshold method on a dataset like MNIST
run_conformal_evaluation_aps: run a conformal prediction evaluation using the APS method on a dataset like CIFAR10
run_evaluation_with_logging: run a conformal prediction evaluation and log results to a file in the experiment path
run_evaluation_cifar100: run a conformal prediction evaluation on CIFAR100 with groups and hierarchy analysis
run_evaluation_fashion_mnist: run a conformal prediction evaluation on Fashion-MNIST with singleton group analysis
